title: Testing the limits of Opus 5.5 with a Souls-like
author: vrdrift
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1wppqj0/video/kdhy6tmk7mrh1/player

A follow up to a Souls-like I made previously with Fable+Opus5. Obviously Opus 5.5 is a massive step up for game design.

\- All art/animations/game-code are made with Opus 5.5  
\- Music/SFX from various free sources  
\- Built in about half a day

It was built using my Vibemaker light weight game engine that is designed specifically for an automated AI agent workflow. I will be releasing Vibemaker for free, and you can create games with it license free.

I view Opus 5.5 as the first model that is really suitable for professional game design. And a very good generative exploration tool. But not yet a production ready art tool - probably two more major AI model revisions and it will be.

replies.author: vrdrift
replies.body: It's going to be free - but I am not committing to make it open source immediately. Although eventually I will consider it.
